171:t_1:169.en:
$$アスラン$$
「Fight, $$キラ$$! To put a stop to this!」

171:t_1:170.en:
$$ラクス$$
「Go, $$キラ$$! Add my feelings to your strength!」

171:t_1:175.en: ～ $$プラント$$ Supreme Council: Chairman's Office ～

171:t_1:177.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Heh... I suppose the times have begun to move because of my declaration.」

171:t_1:178.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$プラント$$ and $$ジオン$$, both people of space... And together they will awaken as a new humanity...」

171:t_1:179.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「All that remains is someone to unite that power, and everything will fall into place.」

171:t_1:180.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I shall have you play that role.」

171:t_2:4.en:
$$ブライト$$
「...To think there was such a story behind the birth of the $$コーディネイター$$s.」

171:t_2:5.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「The upper echelons of $$ザフト$$ already know this fact, and have agreed to side with $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

171:t_2:6.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「The $$クライン$$ faction, which had stood against $$ジオン$$, has joined them as well, and $$プラント$$ is now fully moving toward war with the $$地球連邦$$.」

171:t_2:7.en:
$$ブライト$$
「What about $$イザーク$$ and $$ディアッカ$$?」

171:t_2:8.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「Their whereabouts are unknown... I can't imagine them approving of $$ザフト$$'s current ways...」

171:t_2:9.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「They are probably either in custody, or have escaped on their own.」

171:t_2:10.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「So the $$ザフト$$ leadership learned the truth before $$ラクス$$ did, and made contact with $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

171:t_2:11.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「As for that, I believe former $$クロノ$$ Reformists among the pro-war faction were involved.」

171:t_2:12.en:
$$ブライト$$
「And now the $$サイデリアル$$ have joined in on top of that...」

171:t_2:13.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But isn't that contradictory? ...The $$クロノ$$ Reformists are opposed to the Conservatives, and the Conservatives are connected to the $$サイデリアル$$...」

171:t_2:14.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The Conservatives target the Spacenoids, yet the $$サイデリアル$$ behind them are backing $$ネオ・ジオン$$ and $$プラント$$.」

171:t_2:15.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「On that point, I think the key is what $$フル・フロンタル$$ said, the phrase 'successor to Earth's humanity.'」

171:t_2:17.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Originally the backers of the $$クロノ$$ Conservatives, the $$サイデリアル$$ are probably hedging their bets between them and the Spacenoids they should be targeting.」

171:t_2:18.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「On the assumption that they recognize whichever side wins as the successor to Earth's humanity.」

171:t_2:19.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You mean they'll make Earthlings kill each other...!」

171:t_2:20.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「The $$ジェミニス$$ did the same thing. To them, our lives and ideals must be nothing worth noticing.」

171:t_2:21.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Being played like puppets by something like that...!」

171:t_2:22.en:
$$アムロ$$
(Doesn't $$フル・フロンタル$$ realize that...?)

171:t_2:23.en:
$$アムロ$$
(No... he's an even more cunning man than $$シャア$$... That's inconceivable...)

171:t_2:25.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「We have no choice but to defeat the $$新地球皇国$$, the source of it all.」

171:t_2:26.en:
$$セツコ$$
「The $$サイデリアル$$ are shifting the bulk of their forces from the $$翠の地球$$ to the $$蒼の地球$$.」

171:t_2:27.en:
$$ブライト$$
「$$セツコ$$... You were on the $$翠の地球$$?」

171:t_2:28.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Yes... With $$ランド$$ and $$クロウ$$... and $$アドヴェント#pilot$$.」

171:t_2:30.en:
$$セツコ$$
「It wasn't for very long, but we fought the $$サイデリアル$$ on the $$翠の地球$$ together with him.」

171:t_2:32.en:
$$シン$$
「Look up, $n. We don't have time to be hanging our heads.」

171:t_2:33.en:
$$キラ$$
「$$シン$$ is right. If a path has been shown to us, we'll move forward along it.」

171:t_2:34.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「$$キラ$$... And what about $$ラクス$$...?」

171:t_2:35.en:
$$キラ$$
「I'd be lying if I said I wasn't worried, but $$アスラン$$ and Captain $$バルトフェルド$$ and the others are in $$プラント$$ too.」

171:t_2:36.en:
$$キラ$$
「I believe $$ラクス$$ is safe, for sure.」

171:t_2:39.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You didn't know he'd become like that...?」

171:t_2:40.en:
$$シン$$
「It's because of his health. He didn't join $$ザフト$$; he was recuperating.」

171:t_2:44.en:
$$キラ$$
「...I'll tell you. $$レイ・ザ・バレル$$... is a clone of a certain person.」

171:t_2:45.en:
$$バナージ$$
(A clone... Just like $$マリーダ$$...)

171:t_2:46.en:
$$キラ$$
「And because of a chromosomal abnormality, he doesn't have long to live...」

171:t_2:48.en:
$$シン$$
「$$レイ#pt136$$ is trying to create a future for the $$コーディネイター$$s with what little life he has left...」

171:t_2:50.en:
$$シン$$
「I know. ...I won't accept a future built on top of war.」

171:t_2:51.en:
$$シン$$
「If $$レイ#pt136$$ chose that, I'll stop him. Not with fighting, but with words.」

171:t_2:52.en:
$$セツコ$$
「You can do it, $$シン$$... You, who have overcome sorrow.」

171:t_2:54.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「You never change. You're always so soft when it comes to $$セツコ$$.」

171:t_2:56.en:
$n
「Letting your eyes wander to another woman with your girlfriend right there... That's quite unfaithful of you, $$シン$$.」

171:t_2:58.en:
$$セツコ$$
(So he's the Reactor of the $$いがみ合う双子$$...)

171:t_2:59.en:
$$セツコ$$
($$アドヴェント#pilot$$ said... that he would save us...)

171:t_2:60.en:
$$オットー$$
「We just got a transmission from the $$マクロス・クォーター$$. It seems they're heading here from the $$翠の地球$$ as well.」

171:t_2:61.en:
$$オットー$$
「And they're bringing the new forces we've been waiting for.」

171:t_2:62.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「So there is still hope.」

171:t_2:63.en:
$$ブライト$$
「As soon as we rendezvous with them, we will begin preparations to attack $$ラース・バビロン$$, the imperial capital of the $$新地球皇国$$.」

171:t_2:64.en:
$$アムロ$$
「A single-point breakthrough into the heart of the $$サイデリアル$$...」

171:t_2:65.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「A battle with the fate of Earth at stake...」

171:t_2:66.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Heh... I can't wait to show them what I've got!」

171:t_2:67.en:
$n
「You just wait, $$サイデリアル$$... We will make you pay back what you owe... what you owe every last person on Earth.」

171:t_10:5.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I... might have said something unnecessary to $$ハマーン・カーン$$...」

171:t_10:7.en:
$$クェス$$
「Don't worry about it. I've done the same, after all.」
